text: Independent source review found a concrete first-candidate contract error before any parser/native run. That method is absent from the frozen Shared56 CinderLevel and your observed Level27fdab66; it exists only on the tests/fixtures/restore_candidate_level fixture. It is also absent from the actual Shell71 and new native-lunge host. Thus real pause/checkpoint/Retry/Leave donor preparation can reach an unsupported Level call. Do not add a proxy method to the lunge fixture just to conceal this shared contract error. Please use an existing declared whole Player/Level/Shell state path and explicit native identity/pose/input guards, respecting its quiet boundary, rather than relying on a test-only method.
